citations.claim: Component implements multi-strategy slide capture using DOM extraction and API fallbacks
DocsendClient is the main interface class for PDF document downloading
Download method signature accepts URL, email, passcode, and verification_link parameters
_detect_state function identifies document protection state through DOM inspection
DOM extraction uses JavaScript evaluation to find preso-view page-view images
API fallback strategy uses DocSend's internal /page_data/ endpoints
Image download uses httpx for parallel fetching with RGBA to RGB conversion
Component integrates with Centaur SDK for secret management
API key retrieval uses Centaur secret management with fallback to environment variables
Browser-use WebSocket URL construction supports proxy and profile configuration
TLS preparation configures Node.js certificates for corporate firewall environments
Navigation strategy forces rendering by walking through all slides with keyboard events
PDF assembly uses PIL to create multi-page documents with base64 encoding
Verification wall detection looks for specific phrases in page body text
Component depends on browser-use-sdk, httpx, pillow, and playwright
Centaur configuration defines BROWSER_USE_API_KEY as HTTP secret for connect.browser-use.com
Download method handles both running and non-running event loops through thread pool execution
Factory function _client() provides configured DocsendClient instances
Error handling returns structured dictionaries with status, error, and metadata fields
